data.statement: The Sinai covenant establishes a hereditary Levitical priesthood tied to sacrificial service.
data.interpretive_divergence: Interpretations differ on the continuity of this priesthood after the Second Temple.

provenance.label: Finding
provenance.detail: Priestly service under Sinai is hereditary and sacrificial.

provenance.label: Claims used
provenance.detail: Aaronic appointment; Levitical duties; sacrificial calendar.

provenance.label: Supporting evidence
provenance.detail: Priestly legislation across Exodus, Leviticus and Numbers.

provenance.label: Interpretations
provenance.detail: Continuity and cessation readings remain attributed.

provenance.label: Counterviews
provenance.detail: Readings emphasising prophetic critique of sacrificial practice.
